resources.string: Video banane ki suvidha jaldi hi ek update me aayegi. Theme aur bhasha aap abhi Settings me chun sakte hain.

ClearMovie ko apni photos aur videos dekhne dein
ClearMovie aapki gallery ki photos aur videos se aapka video banata hai. Iske baad Android aapse poochega. Please sabhi photos aur videos ki permission dein.
Aapki photos aur videos aapke phone me hi rehte hain. ClearMovie inhe kahin nahi bhejta.
ClearMovie abhi aapki photos nahi dekh sakta
Aap phir bhi photos aur videos chun sakte hain, par ClearMovie ko unki copy banani hogi, jisse phone me zyada jagah lagegi.
Android ab dobara nahi poochega. Settings kholein, Permissions par tap karein, phir Photos and videos me sabhi ki permission dein.
ClearMovie sirf aapki chuni hui photos dekh sakta hai. Baaki jo photos aur videos aap jodenge, unki copy banegi, jisse zyada jagah lagegi.

Inke liye %1$s jagah chahiye, par aapke phone me sirf %2$s khaali hai. Thodi jagah khaali karein, ya kam photos aur videos chunein.

Har file apne phone se ek baar chunein. ClearMovie uski apni copy rakh leta hai.

Aapke videos safe hain. Ye preset use karte rehne ke liye file phir se chunein.
